stances.summary: Trump's $5,000 domestic-goods requirement violates WTO rules, risks trade retaliation
stances.quote: A government check that only spends on American goods is a subsidy contingent on domestic over imported purchases. WTO rules explicitly ban that. So Trump's $5,000 idea is either a slogan with no real content, or a policy that invites a fresh round of retaliatory tariffs.
